task_title: Make visual-review UX judge surface-agnostic and actionable

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (gpt-5.4, rubber-duck) plan review BLOCKED the original 'adapter reshapes equipment -> Node computeGeometryBlockers' approach as byte-for-byte-unsafe. Redesigned to keep the equipment path's two page.evaluate blocks 100% UNTOUCHED and add a separate generic declared-surface path; Node math runs only for declared surfaces. 4 blocking + 5 non-blocking concerns, all resolved: (1) no Node rewrite of equipment blocker math; (2) raw coords for blocker math, rounded only for the table; (3) equipment legacy path kept sticky by not declaring __visualReview on the equipment setup, documented; (4) source='none' emits a loud non-gating warning + artifact field instead of silently passing; (5) findingKey keeps semantic indices, strips only pixel/coord measurements; (6) preserve raw_overall_score, normalize only when all axes finite, gate on blockers independently; (7) coordinate-space (design-space 1280x720) invariant documented in the contract; (8) inventory demo declares a synthetic panel (union of cells) + cell regions and logs harvest source + region count; plus adopted the simpler two-path decomposition.
